regeneration_reason: Regenerated before the 2026-09-02 evidence-panel follow-up and sanitize-html advisory remediation because the prior lock targeted fbfd40a and could not answer the dependency/runtime impact. The current map records the evidence panel styling chain, message placement, sanitizer dependency, and the Web runtime manifests that consume Node/npm dependencies.

nodes.label: Web App Shell
nodes.role: Authentication, dashboard, projects and user-administration shell.

nodes.label: Project Workspace
nodes.role: Project tabs and composition of design, run, Excel/export and recycle-bin panels.

nodes.label: Run Workspace
nodes.role: Run creation/execution and evidence UI. Workspace renders this module; it renders the evidence section as section.panel.evidence-panel, evidence cards, and success/error messages.

nodes.label: Evidence Panel Styling
nodes.role: Evidence-specific card, panel and message spacing rules layered over the shared .panel style. The current product removed evidence-card shadow and gives direct success messages top margin, while the outer evidence panel still inherits the shared panel shadow and direct error messages do not yet receive the same margin.
constraints: Evidence upload behavior and API calls must not change for a presentation-only fix.
Success and error messages shown directly under .evidence-panel occupy the same feedback location.

nodes.label: Shared UI Styles
nodes.role: Global design tokens and shared .panel styling, including the default card shadow inherited by section.panel.evidence-panel.

nodes.label: Run UI Foundations
nodes.role: Run-workspace and evidence upload layout foundations. File selection and clipboard input are grouped, description follows below, and responsive stacking is preserved.

nodes.label: Browser API Client
nodes.role: Same-origin typed fetch wrapper for shell-level endpoints.

nodes.label: Fastify API Core
nodes.role: Authentication/admin routes, CSRF and request-scoped transaction hooks.

nodes.label: Feature Route Registration
nodes.role: Registers feature routes and destructive-concurrency preHandler.

nodes.label: Evidence and Procedure Routes
nodes.role: Evidence upload/download/versioning/delete/restore and retained procedure CRUD.

nodes.label: Markdown Sanitization Utility
nodes.role: Converts Markdown with marked and sanitizes generated HTML with sanitize-html using a narrow tag/attribute/scheme allowlist. No SVG animation elements are allowlisted. Current scanned source shows direct test coverage; no additional runtime caller was identified in the mapped server modules.
constraints: Raw script/iframe/image content and javascript/vbscript/data schemes must not survive.
SVG and SMIL animation tags are not allowlisted.
Dependency audit must still be clean even when the current policy is not exploitable by the advisory payload.

nodes.label: Web Dependency Manifests
nodes.role: Defines and locks Web production/dev dependencies. sanitize-html is currently requested as ^2.17.5 and locked to 2.17.5; npm audit reports GHSA-g8qq-57p8-ggw5 as moderate. sanitize-html 2.17.7 is the patched release and requires Node >=22.12.0.

nodes.label: Web Node Runtime
nodes.role: Pins developer, CI and container Node versions and package engine requirements. Current product uses Node 20.x; dependency remediation to sanitize-html 2.17.7 therefore affects this runtime boundary.

nodes.label: MariaDB Persistence
nodes.role: MariaDB pool and request-local transaction boundary.

flows.label: Evidence UI and feedback
constraints: Outer evidence panel presentation is CSS-only.
Direct success and error feedback should share spacing from preceding evidence content.

flows.label: Markdown sanitization dependency
constraints: A runtime-version change must be verified in CI and the production container.
